arguments.sql:
WITH model_types AS (
    SELECT name, version, COUNT(DISTINCT L1_model) AS type_count
    FROM main.solution_ext
    GROUP BY name, version
),
step_types AS (
    SELECT name, version, step, COUNT(*) AS row_count
    FROM main.model
    GROUP BY name, version, step
),
stack_scores AS (
    SELECT name, version, step, COUNT(*) AS score_count
    FROM main.model_score
    WHERE model = 'Stack'
    GROUP BY name, version, step
),
status_models AS (
    SELECT status, L1_model, name, version, COUNT(*) AS qualifying_steps
    FROM main.stack_ok
    GROUP BY status, L1_model, name, version
)
SELECT status, L1_model,
       COUNT(*) AS model_count,
       SUM(qualifying_steps) AS step_count,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM model_types WHERE type_count > 1) AS models_with_multiple_types,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM step_types WHERE row_count > 1) AS steps_with_multiple_type_rows,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stack_scores WHERE score_count > 1) AS steps_with_multiple_stack_scores,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.stack_ok AS s
        WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM step_types AS m
            WHERE m.name = s.name AND m.version = s.version AND m.step = s.step
        )) AS status_rows_without_matching_model_step
FROM status_models
GROUP BY status, L1_model
ORDER BY status, L1_model

arguments.sql:
WITH model_statuses AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT name, version, L1_model, status
    FROM main.stack_ok
    WHERE status IN ('strong', 'soft')
),
status_counts AS (
    SELECT status, L1_model, COUNT(*) AS occurrence_count
    FROM model_statuses
    GROUP BY status, L1_model
),
ranked_counts AS (
    SELECT status, L1_model, occurrence_count,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY occurrence_count DESC) AS status_rank
    FROM status_counts
)
SELECT status, L1_model, occurrence_count
FROM ranked_counts
WHERE status_rank = 1
ORDER BY status, L1_model
LIMIT -1
